# Requirements-to-Tasks Traceability Checklist: Anonymous Battleship API Contract

**Purpose**: Review whether the specification is complete and precise enough for future `tasks.md` generation, and whether the generated task ledger traces every governing requirement without inventing behavior.
**Created**: 2026-08-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command from the clarified feature specification and project constitution.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality and task-artifact traceability review. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirements and future task artifacts have been reviewed for the stated quality criterion. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

- [x] CHK004 Are additive versus breaking changes, unknown-field handling, release baselines, and migration obligations specified consistently enough for future compatibility tasks? [Consistency, Traceability, Spec §FR-007–FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Does the future task matrix name at least one reviewer-verifiable artifact or task outcome for each contract-product and compatibility requirement? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-008]

## Notes

- Use this checklist after `$speckit-tasks` and before approving the task ledger for `$speckit-analyze` or implementation.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirements-quality and requirements-to-tasks traceability criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require specification clarification, planning detail, task remediation, or reviewer evaluation.
- Do not use a checked marker as evidence that implementation behavior exists or passes.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add review findings inline and link them to the affected specification, plan, task, contract, or evidence artifact.
- Planning review on 2026-08-20 mapped CHK001–CHK040 provisionally to Phase 1 artifacts, future work packages, and proofs in [validation-matrix.md](../contracts/validation-matrix.md); it correctly left the markers unchecked until a generated task ledger could be reviewed.
- Task-ledger closure review on 2026-08-20 confirmed CHK001–CHK040 against the real task IDs, exact paths, P01–P13 proofs, and closure maps in [tasks.md](../tasks.md). These checked markers prove requirements-to-task traceability only; no implementation task or product verification is complete.
- Clarification remediation and clean reanalysis on 2026-08-20 reconfirmed CHK008/CHK012 after fixing public-safe invalid-cookie behavior, CHK038 after restoring evidence-first ownership for lifecycle/presence/leave/terminal/tooling surfaces, and CHK039 after adding current root-documentation, ignore-state, deterministic-tool, and candidate/final-gate coverage. The clean reanalysis confirmed 74/74 requirements, 75 tasks, and zero material findings; planning is finalized and implementation remains unstarted. All checked CHK markers remain planning and traceability evidence, not implementation proof.
